scenarios.expected: A logical Document retains its linear Version chain and the paper's ownership/provenance is visible. Unsupported corrections, failed uploads, and insufficient access do not silently alter a Version or its provenance.
scenarios.actual: 13 browser steps passed, following the article as legal team member: Upload one file, read the v1 row and its filename-derived name; choosing several files opens the bulk import dialog instead of the composer; Add version appends v2 and the earlier round stays readable and unchanged; the same paper uploaded again is a separate chain, not a merge; Edit details renames the Document and adds a description without touching the chain; a hand-set kind can be corrected, Generated redline is not offered, and the pin is untouched; Mark as executed copy pins an earlier Version and a later upload does not move the pin; Make primary moves the designation between separate Documents; a Matter offers no primary or executed-copy control; an archived owning record takes no new paper until it is restored; a Legal only attachment files as a New Document with Confidential preselected; the second destination appends a New Version on an existing Document; Matter comments offer no filing action.
